name: Juabeso-Bia Landscape
summary: Flagship cocoa-forest mosaic study area. Developed pixel-based and object-oriented approaches to separate cocoa agroforestry from natural forest, and documented cocoa expanding into food croplands.

name: Wassa Amenfi Landscape
summary: Produced land use / land cover maps (2016 & 2020) distinguishing intensive cocoa from agroforestry systems for IUCN's RESUPPLY project, with change analysis and field validation.

name: Kwaebibirem & Atiwa West
summary: Study districts for the CIFOR Governing Multifunctional Landscapes project. Field-tested LULC maps (2015–2020) aligned with Ghana's national REDD+ monitoring protocols.

name: Atewa Range Forest Reserve
summary: Investigated how agriculture-driven habitat modification shapes small mammal communities in this upland evergreen forest — a critical biodiversity and watershed hotspot.

name: Bimpong Forest Reserve
summary: Paired study site with Atewa for comparing small mammal assemblages and demography across forest ecosystems under different disturbance pressures.

name: Keta Lagoon Complex (Ramsar Site)
summary: Mapped mangroves with Sentinel-1 radar data to support conservation and restoration decisions in Ghana's largest Ramsar wetland — radar sees through the persistent coastal cloud cover.

name: Owabi Wetland Sanctuary
summary: Used dragonflies and damselflies (Odonata) as bioindicators to monitor anthropogenic disturbance around this protected wetland near Kumasi.

name: Kpeshie Lagoon Basin
summary: Analysed and predicted land use / land cover dynamics in this urban coastal lagoon basin using satellite remote sensing and transition modelling.

name: Mole National Park
summary: Modelled seasonal habitat use by African elephants in Ghana's largest protected area, linking movement patterns to landscape and water availability.

name: Kumasi Metropolis
summary: Tracked how urban land transformation affects tree abundance and species richness in Kumasi's second city, as part of wider work on urbanisation's spatio-environmental impacts.

name: Accra Peri-Urban Fringe
summary: Reconstructed 30 years of landscape transformation in rapidly developing peri-urban Accra, quantifying the sprawl of built-up land into farmland and vegetation.

name: White Volta Floodplains
summary: Quantified recent floodplain vegetation change along the White Volta River, linking shifts to flow regimes and riverside land use in the savanna zone.

name: Sunyani West District
summary: Early-career GIS work: modelled wildfire risk from biophysical factors and managed the APERL project's geospatial support for agroforestry livelihoods.
